profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a data center services and colocation company. Its site describes full interconnection capabilities across a global ecosystem that includes data centers, connectivity and cloud services, and says it delivers what it calls the world's largest data center platform, serving deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows. The company describes itself as sustainably built for flexibility, open ecosystems and broad reach.

On AI, the site argues that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps, with inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It promotes its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, saying 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint and that enterprises are moving from AI strategy to execution.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, traded under the ticker DLR, with CIK 0001297996. Litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with 126 entries.
